schema.principle: Même état Luna → N canaux sensoriels indépendants
schema.neurological: Le cerveau reconstruit sa réalité spatio-temporelle depuis les signaux disponibles — pas depuis leur source attendue

channels.audio: Ritual_Sound_System — 639 Hz audible, états comme sons
channels.haptic: Vibration — quantum state felt (stable = calme, superposé = vibration)
channels.data: Data_System — état brut lisible par machines
channels.api: API_System — état exposé à systèmes externes

schema.substitution: Si visual tombe → audio porte le même état. Si audio tombe → haptic. Le système ne devient jamais muet — il parle dans le langage qui reste.

content.doc: Multi-Modal Interface is the architectural principle that justifies why Interface_System has five independent channels. The science: the brain does not perceive reality directly — it constructs a model from sensory signals. When one channel is lost, the brain reroutes and reconstructs from what remains. Blind people navigate space through sound. Deaf people feel music through vibration. The system mirrors this: Visual, Audio, Haptic, Data, API all carry the same Luna state independently. Removing one channel never crashes the others. CanPerceive is true as long as at least one channel is active and coherent. CanSubstitute means the system can gracefully degrade — it never goes dark.
